subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should the existing `logging.consoleStyle: "json"` opt-in guarantee structured JSONL for the additional early CLI and direct-diagnostic paths covered by this PR?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but it changes observable operator output across previously bypassed paths and requires maintainers to define the intended compatibility boundary for scripts and log collectors.

options.title: Accept complete JSONL coverage
options.body: Approve the widened opt-in contract, refresh the branch against current main, and merge after the process probes still show raw command JSON remains separate from log envelopes.

options.title: Limit the scope
options.body: Keep the existing capture and subsystem fixes but exclude any early-startup or direct-diagnostic paths that maintainers intentionally preserve as plain text.

options.title: Pause for a narrower contract
options.body: Defer the branch until maintainers document which console sinks belong to the JSON console-style guarantee.

recommendation.title: Accept complete JSONL coverage
recommendation.body: Approve the widened opt-in contract, refresh the branch against current main, and merge after the process probes still show raw command JSON remains separate from log envelopes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current cross-cutting logging and CLI implementation and are best positioned to clarify its intended output boundary with maintainers.
